03.  The petitioner is convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376-DB of the Indian Penal Code and has been sentenced to undergo life imprisonment.

1 04.
Since there is no other mode available to facilitate him to execute the sale deed from jail, we allow the application partly.
The appellant shall be released on temporary bail for a period of two days, commencing from 1st April, 2026 at 09:00 a.m. to 2nd April, 2026 till 05:00 p.m.
The respondent shall make necessary arrangements for security upon payment to be made by the petitioner.
The amount for security arrangement shall be quantified and informed to the appellant by 27 th March, 2026.
In turn, the appellant shall deposit the amount by 30 th March, 2026.

The appellant shall make necessary arrangements to get the documents executed either on 1st April,
2026 or 2nd April, 2026.
05.
We make it clear that we will not extend the time period.
The appellant himself shall surrender by 05:00 p.m. on 2 nd April, 2026.
The security deputed shall also ensure compliance of this order.
The appellant shall file a report of compliance by 6th April, 2026.
06. The application is disposed of in terms of above.

07. List the matter on 7th April, 2026.
